pages.title: Dust in a Circle
pages.text: Successfully create a storm using an obtained Sandstorm in a Bottle or Ancient Spear.

pages.title: Dust in a Circle
pages.text: Use a moving storm as its own tool rather than another ordinary melee hit.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The bottle makes two orbiting storms; Ancient Spear launches a storm with attack. Final Fractal benefits against high maximum health, while Zweiender rewards rear hits. Those are separate properties of the earned weapons, not a generic sword effect.
